topic: GTA Vice City nostalgia: the 2002 game set in 1986
why_selected: Creator's fallback request after the GTA VI launch package was held.
research_summary: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City was released in North America on 27 October 2002 and is set in 1986 in Vice City, a fictional city inspired by Miami, as 20th-anniversary features from Game*Spark, GamingBible and NME describe. Its protagonist, Tommy Vercetti, was voiced by Ray Liotta; Game Informer and VideoGamesChronicle both said so in their May 2022 obituaries, and Rockstar's own tribute called him the iconic voice of Tommy Vercetti. NME says the music was plucked almost entirely from the 1980s. The claim that Billie Jean was later removed over licensing rests only on a blog and a fan wiki and is left out. No official page could be opened here.
uncertainties: No official Rockstar page could be opened; facts rest on dated independent reports (MEDIUM, low-risk historical).
context: GTA VI returns to Vice City; its launch facts are on HOLD today pending verification.
script:
2002 mein ek game aayi thi jo 1986 mein set thi.

Neon lights, Hawaiian shirts, aur Miami se inspired ek sheher: Vice City.

Hero tha Tommy Vercetti, aur uski awaaz thi Hollywood actor Ray Liotta ki.

Lekin is game ka asli jaadu tha uska radio. Gaadi mein baitho, aur 80s ke asli gaane bajne lagte the. Zyada-tar music licensed tha: real songs, real artists.

Isiliye Vice City ek game kam, aur ek time machine zyada lagti thi.

Aur sach batao, aapne bhi kabhi mission chhod ke sirf gaadi chalayi hai na, bas gaane sunne ke liye?

Vice City ki aapki sabse pehli yaad kya hai?
